svg.title: CIHE Security Awareness Poster — Don't Take the Bait
svg.desc: Blue, white and red security awareness poster for CIHE covering phishing, vishing and smishing.
svg.text: Recognise social engineering attacks before it's too late
"Act now or your account will be locked!"
Button says "CIHE Portal" but opens unknown URL
"Dear User" instead of your real name
Legit IT will never ask for your password
Browser shows "Not Secure" in address bar
REMEMBER: Legitimate IT staff will NEVER ask for your password
When in doubt, do not click. Report it instead.
When in doubt — throw it out! 🎣
Report suspicious emails: security@cihe.edu.au | IT Helpdesk: ext. 1234
Prashan Manandhar | Crown Institute of Higher Education
